content.value: Differentiate betwecn sunk costs and marginal costs. A construction company bought a 180,000 metric ton earth sifter at a cost of \$ 65,000. The compaņy expects to keep the equipment a maximum of 7 ycars. The operating cost is expected to follow the series described by 40,000+10,000 K, where K is the number of years since it was purchased ( K= 1,2, ...,7). The salvage value is estimated to be \$30,000 for years 1 and 2 and \$20,000 for years 3 through 7. At an interest rate of 10% per year, determine the economic service life and the associated equivalent annual cost of the sifter.
